subjects.description: An approved HUBB matte-black sunflower-seed pouch standing upright as the hero product, with visible Arabic calligraphy, gold HUBB mark, flavor brushstroke and collectible 01/07 numbering.
subjects.appearance_details: Soft-black pack with tactile foil and matte contrast, flavor color entering only through the painted brushstroke, naturally roasted striped sunflower seeds printed on the lower panel, golden kernel in the cracked seed.
subjects.relationship: The pouch is grounded on warm sandstone among real roasted seeds, salt and flavor ingredients.
subjects.relative_size: Large within frame, readable at thumbnail size
subjects.orientation: Upright, slight three-quarter turn toward camera-left light
subjects.action: Holds still while the camera makes a slow tactile push-in
subjects.state_changes: Light rakes across foil and matte panels; flavor worlds change by chapter

background_setting: Warm AlUla-inspired sandstone and soft-black studio surfaces. Naturally roasted sunflower seeds, split shells and golden kernels occupy the foreground. No people, no hands, no factory, no generic desert luxury set.

lighting.conditions: Golden-hour raking light with controlled studio fill
lighting.direction: Camera-left key, soft bounce from sandstone
lighting.shadows: Long tactile contact shadows under the pouch
lighting.illumination_effect: Premium commercial food lighting that keeps pack typography readable

aesthetics.composition: Product-led cinematic framing with ingredient world in the lower third
aesthetics.color_scheme: Soft black, bone, gold, and one live flavor accent at a time
aesthetics.patterns: Subtle modern Najdi Sadu rhythm in light and shadow only

cinematography.depth_of_field: Shallow, pack sharp, ingredients softly tactile
cinematography.focus: Pack brand mark and flavor brushstroke

context: HUBB seven-flavor pack study for the website film stage

actions.description: Seven chapters, one SKU each: Classic, Lemon Salt, Hot & Salt, Spices, Ghawa, Matcha, Americano. Camera eases in. Matcha kernels remain naturally roasted gold.

segments.description: Continuous seven-world pack study with physically accurate lighting and materials.
segments.key_changes: Flavor color and ingredient world change every chapter

temporal_caption: A 15-second cinematic pack study of seven HUBB sunflower-seed pouches, each standing in its own ingredient world under golden Saudi light, ending on Americano.
